```{r}
sky_brightness <- read.csv(
  "sky_brightness_measurements.csv"
)


sky_brightness <- sky_brightness %>%
  mutate(
     file_name_clean = 
        tools::file_path_sans_ext(filename),
     site = 
        stringr::word(file_name_clean, 2, sep = "_"),
  )

sky_brightness <- sky_brightness %>%
  mutate(site = toupper(site))

sky_brightness <- sky_brightness %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_brightness_site = mean(mean_brightness, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

data_env <- data_env %>%
  left_join(
    sky_brightness,
    by = "site"
  )
data_env <- data_env %>%
  filter(
      !is.na(mean_brightness_site)
    )
```

```{r}
library(glmmTMB)
library(emmeans)
library(ggeffects)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

# ── Shared theme ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Clean white-background publication style with warm field-science accent tones
bat_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.background    = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#EBEBEB", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.line          = element_line(color = "#444444", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks         = element_line(color = "#444444"),
    axis.text          = element_text(color = "#333333", size = 10),
    axis.title         = element_text(color = "#222222", size = 11),
    plot.title         = element_text(color = "#111111", size = 13,
                                      face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 3)),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(color = "#666666", size = 9,
                                      margin = margin(b = 8)),
    legend.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.key         = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.text        = element_text(color = "#333333", size = 10),
    legend.title       = element_text(color = "#444444", size = 9,
                                      face = "bold"),
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "#F2F2F2", color = NA),
    strip.text         = element_text(color = "#222222", face = "bold",
                                      size = 10),
    plot.caption       = element_text(color = "#999999", size = 8,
                                      hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 8)),
    plot.margin        = margin(12, 14, 10, 12)
  )

# Color palette — red/white light as primary contrast, muted supporting colors
col_red    <- "#C0392B"
col_white  <- "#2E86AB"   # blue stands in for white light (visible on plot)
col_ribbon <- 0.15        # ribbon alpha
col_pts    <- "#555555"
col_yr     <- c("2019" = "#264653", "2020" = "#2A9D8F", "2021" = "#E9C46A",
                "2022" = "#F4A261", "2023" = "#E76F51", "2024" = "#A8DADC")
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# ── SPECIES MODELS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Run one model per species; store results for unified figure
# =============================================================================

# Get species list from your data
species_list <- unique(data_env$species)
cat("Fitting models for", length(species_list), "species...\n")

# ── Fit per-species models ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
sp_models <- list()

for (sp in species_list) {

  dat_sp <- data_env |> filter(species == sp)

  # Skip if too few detections to fit reliably
  if (sum(dat_sp$detections) < 30 | nrow(dat_sp) < 20) {
    cat("  Skipping", sp, "— insufficient data\n")
    next
  }

  cat("  Fitting:", sp, "\n")

  sp_models[[sp]] <- tryCatch(
    glmmTMB(
      detections ~ jd + I(jd^2) + mean_phase + pct_nonforest +
        intensity * color + mean_brightness_site + block + year + (1 | site),
      family  = nbinom2,
      data    = dat_sp,
      control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim,
                               optArgs   = list(method = "BFGS"))
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("  ERROR fitting", sp, ":", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )
}

# Remove failed models
sp_models <- sp_models[!sapply(sp_models, is.null)]
cat("Successfully fit models for:", paste(names(sp_models), collapse = ", "), "\n")


# ── Extract color × intensity emmeans for all species ─────────────────────────
extract_color_intensity <- function(mod, sp_name) {
  emm <- tryCatch(
    emmeans(mod, ~ color | intensity,
            at   = list(intensity = c(10, 50, 100)),
            type = "response"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(emm)) return(NULL)
  as.data.frame(emm) |> mutate(species = sp_name)
}

df_sp_ci <- map2_dfr(sp_models, names(sp_models), extract_color_intensity)


# ── Extract intensity slopes per color per species (emtrends) ─────────────────
extract_slopes <- function(mod, sp_name) {
  slopes <- tryCatch(
    emtrends(mod, ~ color, var = "intensity"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(slopes)) return(NULL)
  as.data.frame(slopes) |> mutate(species = sp_name)
}

df_slopes <- map2_dfr(sp_models, names(sp_models), extract_slopes)


# ── Extract overall species marginal means (color main effect) ────────────────
extract_color_main <- function(mod, sp_name) {
  emm <- tryCatch(
    emmeans(mod, ~ color, type = "response"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(emm)) return(NULL)
  as.data.frame(emm) |> mutate(species = sp_name)
}

df_sp_color <- map2_dfr(sp_models, names(sp_models), extract_color_main)

```

```{r}
# ── Fig S1: Color effect by species (dot plot) ────────────────────────────────
df_sp_color_wide <- df_sp_color |>
  select(species, color, response) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = color, values_from = response) |>
  mutate(
    ratio    = W / R,                      # >1 means more detections under white
    direction = ifelse(ratio < 1, "White suppresses", "White enhances")
  ) |>
  arrange(ratio) |>
  mutate(species = fct_inorder(species))

fig_s1 <- ggplot(df_sp_color, aes(x = response,
                                    y = fct_reorder(species, response),
                                    color = color)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = species), color = "#CCCCCC", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = asymp.LCL, xmax = asymp.UCL),
                width = 0.3, linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(R = col_red, W = col_white),
                     labels = c(R = "Red", W = "White"),
                     name   = "Light color") +
  labs(
    title    = "Light Color Effect on Bat Detections by Species",
    subtitle = "Marginal means ± 95% CI from per-species negative binomial GLMMs",
    x        = "Predicted detections per night",
    y        = NULL,
    caption  = "Connected lines link red/white estimates for the same species"
  ) +
  bat_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
# ── Fig S4: Heatmap — ratio of white:red detections by species × intensity ────
# Signature figure: immediately shows which species/intensity combos are affected
df_heat <- df_sp_ci |>
  select(species, color, intensity, response) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = color, values_from = response) |>
  mutate(
    log2_ratio = log2(W / R),    # 0 = no difference; <0 = white suppresses
    intensity  = factor(intensity, levels = c(10, 50, 100),
                        labels = c("Low (10%)", "Mid (50%)", "High (100%)"))
  )

fig_s4 <- ggplot(df_heat,
                  aes(x = intensity,
                      y = fct_reorder(species, log2_ratio, .fun = mean),
                      fill = log2_ratio)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(log2_ratio, 2)),
            color = "white", size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low      = col_red,
    mid      = "#F5F5F5",
    high     = col_white,
    midpoint = 0,
    name     = "log₂(White/Red)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "White vs. Red Light Effect by Species and Intensity",
    subtitle = "Negative values (red) = white light suppresses relative to red",
    x        = "Light intensity",
    y        = NULL,
    caption  = "log₂ ratio of predicted detections: white ÷ red"
  ) +
  bat_theme +
  theme(
    panel.grid  = element_blank(),
    axis.line   = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks  = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

fig_s4
```

```{r}
# Main model: intensity slopes by color

  as.data.frame() |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4)))

# Main model: color contrast at anchor intensities
contrast_main <- emmeans(models$m2, ~ color | intensity,
                          at = list(intensity = c(100,80,85,65,70,90,95,75,10,50,30,60)),
                          type = "response") |>
  pairs() |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4)))
write_csv(contrast_main, "posthoc_color_by_intensity_main.csv")

# Species: slopes table
write_csv(df_slopes, "posthoc_intensity_slopes_by_species.csv")

# Species: color contrasts at anchor intensities
sp_contrasts <- df_sp_ci |>
  group_by(species) |>
  group_modify(~ {
    # rebuild emmGrid from stored predictions isn't possible post-hoc,
    # so flag this for manual extraction if needed
    tibble(note = "Run pairs() on each sp_models[[sp]] emmeans object individually")
  })

cat("\nFor species-level pairwise contrasts, run:\n")
cat("  pairs(emmeans(sp_models[['EPFU']], ~ color | intensity,\n")
cat("        at = list(intensity = c(10,50,100)), type = 'response'))\n")
```

```{r}
source("04_Occurrence_Thresholds.R")

occurrences <- run_thresholds(data_env, thresholds = c(30, 60, 120, 300))

glimpse(occurrences)

occurrences %>%
  ggplot(aes(threshold_sec, occurrences, group = site, color = site)) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3)

occurrences %>%
  group_by(threshold_sec) %>%
  summarise(total_occurrences = sum(occurrences))

data_30 <- occurrences %>%
  filter(threshold_sec == 30)

data_60 <- occurrences %>%
  filter(threshold_sec == 60)

data_120 <- occurrences %>%
  filter(threshold_sec == 120)

data_300 <- occurrences %>%
  filter(threshold_sec == 300)

site_env <- data_env %>%
  distinct(site, pct_forest)

occurrences <- occurrences %>%
  left_join(site_env, by = "site")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

effort <- data_env %>%
  group_by(site, year, color, intensity) %>%
  summarise(
    nights = n_distinct(date),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

comm_dat <- data_env %>%
  group_by(site,
           year,
           color,
           intensity,
           species,
           block) %>%
  summarise(
    detections = sum(detections),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

comm_dat <- comm_dat %>%
  left_join(
    effort,
    by = c("site", 'year', 'color', 'intensity')
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    det_per_night = detections/nights
  )

```

```{r}
community_matrix <- comm_dat %>%
  select(site,
         year,
         color,
         intensity,
         species,
         block,
         det_per_night
         ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = species,
    values_from = det_per_night,
    values_fill = 0
  )

env <- data_env %>%
  group_by(site,
           year,
           color,
           intensity) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_phase = first(mean_phase),
    pct_nonforest = first(pct_nonforest),
    mean_brightness_site = first(mean_brightness_site),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

community_matrix <- community_matrix %>%
  left_join(
    env,
    by = c('site',
           'year',
           'color',
           'intensity')
  )

species_cols <- setdiff(
  names(community_matrix),
  c('site',
    'year',
    'color',
    'intensity',
    'mean_phase',
    'pct_nonforest',
    'mean_brightness_site',
    'block')
)

comm <- community_matrix %>%
  select(all_of(species_cols))

env <- community_matrix %>%
  select(site,
         year,
         color,
         intensity,
         mean_phase,
         pct_nonforest,
         mean_brightness_site,
         block)
```

```{r}
library(vegan)

nmds <- metaMDS(
  comm,
  distance = 'bray',
  k = 2,
  trymax = 100
)

nmds$stress
```

```{r}

adonis2(
  comm ~ color +
    intensity +
    mean_phase +
    pct_nonforest +
    mean_brightness_site +
    block +
    (1|year),
  data = env,
  method = 'bray',
  permutatins = 9999
)

bc <- vegdist(comm, method = 'bray')

bd <- betadisper(bc, group = env$color)

anova(bd)
```

```{r}
db <- dbrda(
  comm ~ color +
    intensity +
    mean_phase +
    pct_nonforest +
    mean_brightness_site +
    block +
    Condition(year),
  data = env,
  distance = 'bray'
)

anova(db, permutations = 9999)

anova(db,
      by = 'margin',
      permutations = 9999)

```

```{r}

ggplot(site_scores,
       aes(dbRDA1,
           dbRDA2,
           color = color,
           size = intensity)) +

  facet_wrap(~ year) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
env_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(db, display='bp'))
env_scores$variable <- rownames(env_scores)

ggplot(site_scores,
       aes(dbRDA1,
           dbRDA2,
           color = color)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  
  geom_segment(
    data = env_scores,
    aes(x = 0,
        y = 0,
        xend = dbRDA1,
        yend = dbRDA2),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, 'cm'))
  ) +
  
  geom_text(
    data = env_scores,
    aes(dbRDA1,

        label = variable),

  ) +
```

```{r}
library(mvabund)

newdat <- data_frame(
  intensity = seq(min(data_env$intensity),
                  max(data_env$intensity),
                  length.out = 100),
  color = 'W',
  mean_phase = mean(data_env$mean_phase, na.rm = TRUE),
  pct_nonforest = mean(data_env$pct_nonforest, na.rm = TRUE),
  mean_brightness_site = mean(data_env$mean_brightness_site, na.rm = TRUE),
  year = 2020
)

pred <- predict(fit, newdata = newdat, type = 'response')

pred_df <- as.data.frame(pred) %>%
  mutate(intensity = newdat$intensity) %>%
  pivot_longer(-intensity,
               names_to = 'species',
               values_to = 'predicted')

ggplot(pred_df,
       aes(x = intensity,
           y = predicted,
           color = species)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_classic () +
  labs(y = 'Predicted detections')
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

data_env <- data_env %>%
  mutate(
    block = factor(block,
                   levels = c('three', 'seven', 'zero'))
  )

overall_plot <- data_env %>%
  group_by(block, color) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_det = mean(detections, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(detections, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

ggplot(overall_plot,
       aes(x = factor(block),
           y = mean_det,
           color = color,
           group = color)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_det - se,
        ymax = mean_det +se),
    width = 0.1
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Block",
    y = 'Mean detections',
    color = 'Light color'
  )
```
